Add a meta description targeting a keyword such as 'Okta access control integration case study' or 'automate physical access control with Okta Lifecycle Management' — none currently exists, leaving the page invisible to relevant search queries.

Add H2/H3 subheadings (e.g., 'The Challenge,' 'The Solution,' 'The Results') to give the page a proper content structure that both improves readability and signals topical relevance to search engines.
